purpose: METHOD=BISECTION over a transient: MAX v(out) by 1 us passes above its GOAL, which needs a small enough R.

oracle.derivation: 1 - exp(-1 us / (R 1 nF)) = 0.5 at R = 1e-6 / (1e-9 ln 2) = 1442.695 ohm; the window ends within 1e-6 * 9900 ohm.

notes: The tolerance covers the transient's truncation error in v(out) at 1 us.
